title: A failed or refused review-record post does not count as posted
why: A record post that failed or was refused by a hook still counts as posted, so a builder spawn is allowed with no record on the PR.
note: From lane record-after-each-round, round 3 reviewer (sonnet) PASS on #1678, 01:34 CST Nov 10. hooks/guard_merge.py review_record_hit (~:1709, :1625): an is_error add_issue_comment with the marker, or a cloud-refused Bash gh pr comment, counts as the posted record; `failed` (~:1693) filters only reviewer spawns. Proof: scratch transcript; builder spawn allowed. Fix: skip posts whose tool_use id is in `failed`, plus a case and a mutant. Starts after #1678 merges. Coordinator 11:58 CST Nov 13: doing, express, one lane for all three, session_013NEJL2GJYfRpFUNEkfT6QN. Incident: in the cloud `merge --review-record` printed PASS on #3138 while its gh write was refused and no comment posted; likely the cause of today's "no record" reads on #3141, #3146, #3136 and #2870. Split 14:00 CST Nov 13 (lane review-record-readback (session_013NEJL2GJYfRpFUNEkfT6QN), PR #3235, 14:00 CST Nov 13): PR #3235 builds the merge-tool read-back; the incident pattern PASS-then-failed-post is in `merge --lane-lint` (new step lane-lint-failed-post-fails); the hooks/guard_merge.py half is new step failed-post-counts-as-record-guard. Sightings 14:19 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 14:42, runner 10 14:18): `merge --review-record` printed "nothing was posted" for #3226 (head 29e2b9461) and for #3192 and others; lanes hand-posted the printed lines with the footer (#3226 comment 6863843498, 14:18 CST). Under `verdict` the "nothing was posted" line is hidden and only PASS shows; the log has it (lane mutate-sweep-control). Cure: PR #3235 (record read-back fix), earliest batch. Owner has not ruled on hand-posting: page item 762 (pick-hand-post-record-stopgap). Triage has read none of these. Owner 14:24 CST: item 762 a, hand-posting the printed lines is allowed until #3235 lands (ruling own-762-a-hand-post-stopgap).
